decisions.reason: The test listed only argument forms for unlink and shred, so the bare rules could be removed without a failure. The plan now matches the bare forms of both commands as well as the argument forms.

The project policy asks the owner whether to run a security review when a change touches a permission, and the security review capability is installed. The plan now has a checkpoint before the steps that asks the owner, runs one only on request and records the answer in the result.

The plan check is the drafting author step and was already run and passed on this plan, but the plan did not say so. I added it to the plan-level verification so it is repeated after any edit, and I note the run in the review record. The reviewer was right that it was not visible in the plan.
